pr_title: GameEngine: implement stateful Behavior Tree runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements the core runtime and authoring slices of ADR 0123. Adds per-runner prepared execution state, memory Sequence/Selector traversal, lifecycle and deterministic abort hooks, a hard step budget, bounded execution snapshots mapped to source NodeIds, and schema-driven Inverter/Wait/Timeout/Cooldown decorators without changing the existing compiled Behavior Tree DTO shape.

The Editor live graph overlay remains a follow-up slice and is not claimed by this PR.
